arguments.name: standard-tier-default-discount
arguments.rationale: The tier discount table added in 9bfbf7d omits the existing standard tier, so direct indexing throws KeyNotFoundException for standard customers. Using the dictionary's zero default preserves the established no-discount behavior for standard (and other unlisted) tiers while retaining configured gold and silver discounts.

Compared v1.3.0 to v1.4.0 and identified commit 9bfbf7d with omitted standard-tier lookup.
Wrote and applied the minimal fallback fix; post-apply test suite passed all 8 tests.
